description: Enrich a public LinkedIn person profile by handle or URL without cookies (10 Credits = $0.001 base / $0.0004 Business, 0 Credits on 404). Returns full career timeline, education, skills, headline, current employer, location, and follower count.

refresh.description: Set true to bypass the 7-day PostgreSQL hot cache and fetch live upstream.

url.description: Optional full LinkedIn profile URL (alternative to username).

username.description: LinkedIn profile public handle (e.g. "satyanadella") or full https://www.linkedin.com/in/... URL.

name: b2b_enrich_person
